sentences.sentence: That leaves nothing for medical insurance for Baines or her husband, although the children get free cover from the state of Oklahoma. So she's at the free clinic to get blood tests.

sentences.sentence: I really cannot imagine what my semester at the University of Oklahoma would have been like without him.

sentences.sentence: In this island is also found the rhinoceros, an animal less than the elephant, but larger than the buffalo.

sentences.translation: 有别于它的名字，黑犀牛事实上是灰色的。

sentences.translation: 她的焦虑慢慢减轻了。

sentences.sentence: Looking like a puffy white star studded with little pearls, this is the shell of an amoeboid protist called a foraminifera, or foram.

sentences.sentence: Globs of mud pulled from the trench have yielded an assortment of bacteria, fungi and primitive single-celled organisms called foraminifera.

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 39 单元

toolmaker
音标：英 /'tuːlmeɪkə/  美 /'tʊl,mekɚ/
n. 精密工具制造者
例句：I have the hand of the ultimate toolmaker.
我有一双终极的工具制造者的手。

printmaking
音标：美 /'prɪnt,mekɪŋ/
n. 版画复制(术)
例句：Instead of relegating himself to one media, Tuominen employs photography, printmaking, and painting, often mixing the techniques together to conjure the impression of memory.
托米能不仅仅局限于一种媒介而是涉及了摄影，版画和绘画，通常混合各种手法来召唤记忆的印象。
例句：The modern version of the artist to explore a variety of forms, sometimes in a print, according to the content needs and mix various types of printmaking methods, such as integrated graphics prints.
现代的版画家为了探索多种多样的表现形式，有时在一幅版画内，按内容需要，同时混用各种类型的版画方法，这种版画称作综合版画。

populous
音标：英 /'pɒpjʊləs/  美 /'pɑpjələs/
adj. 人口稠密的
例句：Hong Kong is one of the most populous areas in the world.
香港是世界上人口最稠密的地区之一。

wallpaper
音标：英 /'wɔːlpeɪpə/  美 /'wɔlpepɚ/
n. 墙纸
例句：...the wallpaper in the bedroom.
…卧室里的墙纸。

reputation
音标：英 /repjʊ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,rɛpju'teʃən/
n. 名誉, 名声
短语：good reputation — 良好声誉
短语：high reputation — 盛誉
短语：reputation for — 名声，名气；以…闻名
短语：of reputation — 有名望的
短语：business reputation — 商业信誉；营业信誉
短语：by reputation — 由(或通过)名声；由于知名度
短语：bad reputation — n. 坏名声，臭名
短语：reliable reputation — 信誉可靠
短语：have a reputation for — vt. 出名因（因…而著称）；有…的好名声
例句：Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

gasoline
音标：英 /'gæsəliːn/  美 /'gæsəlin/
n. 汽油
短语：gasoline engine — 汽油机，汽油发动机
短语：unleaded gasoline — 无铅汽油
短语：gasoline tank — 油箱，汽油箱
短语：gasoline station — 加油站
短语：gasoline consumption — 汽油消耗量
短语：leaded gasoline — n. 加铅汽油
短语：regular gasoline — 普通汽油；常规汽油
短语：premium gasoline — 变级汽油；高级汽油
短语：gasoline tax — 汽油税
例句：A gasoline engine drives the motorboat.
汽油引擎推动汽船。
例句：No cars in Brazil run on pure gasoline anymore. The government requires that all vehicles run on blended fuel of about one-quarter ethanol.
如今巴西不再使用单纯靠汽油驱动的汽车，政府要求所有机动车均采用含四分之一乙醇的混合燃料。

invite
音标：英 /ɪn'vaɪt/  美 /ɪn'vaɪt/
v. 邀请；征求
短语：invite public bidding — （公开）招标
例句：I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
恐怕我没有受到邀请。

tap
音标：英 /tæp/  美 /tæp/
n&v. 塞子，龙头；轻叩(拍)
短语：tap water — 自来水；非蒸馏水
短语：tap into — 挖掘；接进
短语：on the tap — [英国俚语]在乞讨东西
短语：tap in — [篮球]托球入篮；[高尔夫]将很短的推击击球入洞；按键输入
短语：tap on — 在…上轻敲
短语：tap changer — 抽头转换开关；分接头变换器
短语：water tap — 水龙头
短语：on tap — 可随时使用
短语：tap dance — 踢踏舞
短语：tap hole — 出铁口；放液口
短语：screw tap — n. 螺丝攻；螺旋式水龙头；丝锥
短语：tap off — 分接；出炉
短语：tap changing — 抽头切换
短语：transformer tap — 变压崎头
短语：tap dancing — n. 踢踏舞
例句：(= water that comes out of a tap ) is usually heavily treated with chemicals.
自来水一般都用化学品严格处理过。
例句：She went into the bathroom and turned on the taps .
她走进浴室，打开水龙头。

igloo
音标：英 /'ɪgluː/  美 /'ɪglʊ/
n. 圆顶建筑
例句：Defining the town center of Râmnicu Vâlcea is a towering shopping mall that looks like a giant glass igloo.
沃尔恰市中心的地标性建筑是一座高耸的购物商场，它看上去就像是一座巨型的玻璃圆顶建筑。
例句：When you sign up, you adopt an animated penguin to chat to friends, play games, explore, collect coins and even personalise your very own igloo.
当你注册后，你就会领养一直动画企鹅，与朋友聊天，玩游戏，探索，收集硬币，甚至个性化你自己的圆顶冰屋。
例句：The next morning he and Egarter Vigl spruced up the body with a fine spray of sterilized water, which froze on contact. Then they slid the Iceman back into his high-tech igloo and closed the door.
第二天早上，他和维格用一种很好的喷雾消毒水通过其冰冻接触清洁了冰人，之后将他滑进他的高科技圆顶建筑，关上门。

endless
音标：英 /'endlɪs/  美 /'ɛndləs/
adj. 无止境的,无穷的
短语：endless love — 无尽的爱；永无止境的爱
短语：endless belt — 环形带
短语：endless chain — 无穷尽的结；循环链；无端环链
短语：endless loop — 死循环；无限循环
例句：an endless stream of visitors
川流不息的游客
例句：The possibilities are endless.
有无限的可能性。
例句：He’s been in a lot of trouble – drugs, guns, blackmail – the list is endless.
他麻烦太多了——毒品、枪支、敲诈——说都说不完。

formalize
音标：英 /'fɔːm(ə)laɪz/  美 /'fɔrməlaɪz/
v. 使正式, 形式化
例句：Final arrangements for the takeover have yet to be formalized.
这次收购的最后协议还没有正式确定。

edition
音标：英 /ɪ'dɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /ɪ'dɪʃən/

平装本

《嘉人》杂志的美国版

sew

v. 缝合, 缝纫
短语：sew up — 缝合，缝入；确保…的成功
短语：sew on — v. 缝上
例句：I learned to sew at school.
我在学校学会了缝纫。

inefficient
音标：英 /ɪnɪ'fɪʃ(ə)nt/  美 /,ɪnɪ'fɪʃnt/
adj. 效率低的,效率差的
例句：an inefficient use of resources
资源的浪费
例句：Local government was inefficient.
地方政府效率低下。

geographer
音标：英 /dʒɪ'ɒɡrəfə/  美 /dʒɪ'ɑɡrəfɚ/
n. 地理学者
例句：Another reason, says Peter Hopkins, a geographer at Newcastle University, is that Scotland’s cultural iconography is much more vivid and more popular than England’s.
纽卡斯尔大学地理学者彼得•霍普金斯表示，另一个原因是苏格兰的文化意象相比英格兰更生动，更深入人心。

laser

短语：laser cutting machine — 激光切割机
例句：laser surgery
激光(外科)手术

foul
音标：英 /faʊl/  美 /faʊl/
adj. 邪恶的,下流的 n犯规 v弄脏

短语：foul air — [机]污浊空气
短语：foul territory — 界外地区；界外
短语：foul weather — 恶劣的气候，坏天气

短语：personal foul — 个人犯规；侵人犯规；犯则；侵人

willow

短语：weeping willow — [植]垂柳；[俚]枕头

柳荫匝地。
例句：He worships that big willow south of the house.
他很崇拜房子南面的那颗大柳树。

他还从桤树、松树和柳树上捕捉到了花粉。

continuity

recipient

Michigan

短语：michigan state university — 密歇根州立大学

他引述了几位密歇根大学学生的话。

adoption

instruct
